key_insight: GDSW-type two-level Schwarz preconditioners support scalable high-order 3D solves, but VEM requires moment-based representation of operator kernels to preserve coarse-level effectiveness for polynomial degrees k ≥ 3.
engineering_relevance: These preconditioners can improve parallel solver scalability for high-order Poisson and linear-elasticity simulations.
method: Study GDSW, GDSW*, and reduced GDSW coarse spaces in overlapping additive Schwarz preconditioners.
Represent operator kernels through face moments when constructing VEM coarse basis functions.
Evaluate FEM on hexahedral meshes and VEM on hexahedral and polyhedral meshes.
evidence_signal: Tests reach polynomial degree k = 5 and 4,096 subdomains and parallel cores, showing scalable Poisson iteration counts across all variants and extension of the moment-based construction to linear elasticity.
watch_item: For 3D VEM at k ≥ 3, omitting the moment-based correction makes the coarse level ineffective, so construction is not purely algebraic.
paper_title: Two-level additive Schwarz preconditioners with GDSW coarse spaces for high-order discretizations in 3D
